events.title: Generic Fighter Maybe is in next fest!
events.summary: Next Fest just got started, and Generic Fighter Maybe is a part of it! Watch our pre-recorded broadcast (it'll stream all week long!) and play the Demo! https://steamcommunity.com/broadcast/watch/76561199084214857

events.title: The Online Playtest has begun!
events.summary: The online playtest has just started! We decided at the last second to just make it completely open. Just hit Play Now in the game's store page, and you're in! Like we mentioned in the previous announcement, this is the first time we're testing this game's netcode in a public environment, so there's bound to be issues. events.title: First Online Playtest!
events.summary: Only two days left for the playtest! I you haven't already, sign up to get a chance to try the game's online mode for the first time ever! It'll run from October 12 to October 18, ending just as Next Fest begins! This test uses our own custom rollback system, which works with Steam's lobby system. This is the first time we're trying it out publicly, so things are probably not gonna be 100% flawless. events.title: Development Update: Online Lobbies
events.summary: Hey there! This is Khao, the lead dev for GFM. Things have been quiet for a bit, but I've been making a ton of progress behind the scenes, and I wanted to show-off some of the progress so you know where we're at right now. After the playtest, about 90% of the work has been dedicated to online play. events.title: Playtest begins!
events.summary: The first Generic Fighter Maybe playtest begins today! The game will be available to play for an entire week, until May 7th! events.summary: You'll finally get a chance to test the game on May 1st!This is a chance to try out all the new characters we've been working on. We've got 4 characters ready to go! events.title: Fuluglugli VS Glorbolgo - Full match
events.summary: Happy new year! This is gonna be a great year for Generic Fighter Maybe, I've already made some great progress with development, and to share a little bit with you, I prepared a gameplay video showing a full match with 2 of the new characters: Fuluglugli, the generic Zoner, and Glorbolgo, the generic Rushdown!Can't wait to let everyone try these characters for themselves! In the meantime, I hope you enjoy the video!
